title: Krispy Kreme® Appoints Suk Nicholas as Chief Commercial Officer and Lori Suess as Chief People Officer
summary: Internal promotions strengthen Global Leadership Team as Company remains focused on sustainable, profitable growth Krispy Kreme, Inc. (NASDAQ: DNUT) (“Krispy Kreme” or the “Company”) today announced the appointment of Suk Nicholas as Chief Commercial Officer and Lori Suess as Chief People Officer, effective August 3, 2026. In the newly created role of Chief Commercial Officer, Ms. Nicholas will join Krispy Kreme's Global Leadership Team and lead the Company’s fresh delivery business in the U.S. and internationally. She will oversee the development and execution of enterprise sales strategies to accelerate growth, expand key partnerships and revenue opportunities, strengthen customer relationships, and build world-class commercial capabilities across markets. Ms. Nicholas brings more than 15 years of Krispy Kreme experience, having joined Krispy Kreme U.K. Ireland in 2010 before moving to the Company’s global team in 2023.
